title: Toyota Prius 油電混合車
summary: 從公開THS架構出發，用能量帳、理想齒輪、回生與儲能例題理解Prius油電整合，並練習公平比較不同駕駛與世代條件。
summaryEn: Start from the public THS architecture and use energy balances, ideal gearing, regeneration and storage exercises to understand Prius hybrid integration and fair comparisons.
scope: 12道原創概念任務；1997與2003資料僅用於架構及歷史。數值不是任何Prius的ECU標定、電池規格或制動設定；不進行高壓系統拆裝或車輛改裝。
scopeEn: Twelve original conceptual tasks; 1997 and 2003 sources support architecture and history. Values are not Prius ECU calibration, battery specifications or brake settings. No high-voltage disassembly or vehicle modification.

stages.title: 能量邊界與分流原理
stages.description: 先畫能量流，再以功率、時間和理想速度約束檢查單位與邊界。
stages.descriptionEn: Map energy flows, then check units and boundaries through power, time and ideal speed constraints.
stages.route: 原創概念學習路線；工序編號是教學順序，不是原廠連續製造或操作程序。
stages.routeEn: An original conceptual learning route; numbering indicates teaching order, not a continuous manufacturer production or operating procedure.

steps.title: 界定油電系統的能量邊界
steps.objective: 辨識燃油、電池、車輪功與熱的能量角色。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the energy roles of fuel, battery, wheel work and heat.
steps.instruction: 畫燃油、引擎、發電機、電池、馬達與車輪方塊。以箭頭連接可能能量流，另畫散熱出口；比較行程時保留電池起終儲能，避免把回生當成新能量來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw fuel, engine, generator, battery, motor and wheel blocks. Connect possible energy paths and add heat exits. Retain initial and final battery energy when comparing trips, rather than treating regeneration as a new energy source.
steps.observation: 電池可在不同時刻吸收或釋放能量，其起終差影響比較。
steps.observationEn: The battery can absorb or release energy at different times; its net change affects comparisons.
steps.failure: 只看燃油消耗，卻忽略行程結束時電池少了能量，會偏估效率。
steps.failureEn: Comparing fuel alone while ignoring a depleted battery biases the efficiency assessment.
steps.check: 圖上有能量輸入、儲存、有用輸出與損失四類。
steps.checkEn: Show energy input, storage, useful output and losses.

knowledge.title: 能量守恆
knowledge.text: 能量轉換會改變形式，回生不會憑空創造能量。
knowledge.textEn: Conversion changes energy form; regeneration does not create energy.

knowledge.title: 比較邊界
knowledge.text: 相同行程也要比較電池儲能變化，才有一致邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Even equal trips require battery-energy changes to establish a consistent boundary.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「Toyota Prius 油電混合車」的「界定油電系統的能量邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出儲能、驅動、熱路徑、感測與停止的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「車輛台架：續航與停止」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓車模的負載、能源、時間與停止位置紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Define the hybrid energy boundary” in “Toyota Prius hybrid vehicle”. Draw the storage, drive, thermal path, sensing and stopping boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Vehicle Bench: Endurance and Stopping” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for load, energy, timing and stopping-position records from an isolated low-voltage model, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 哪項必須納入兩次行程的公平能量比較？
quiz.questionEn: What must be included for a fair energy comparison between two trips?
options: 只比較燃油消耗，即使電池終點不同
把回生當成系統外新增的能量輸入
電池起點與終點的儲能差
optionsEn: Compare fuel alone even when final battery states differ
Treat regeneration as new energy entering from outside the system
quiz.explanation: 電池能量差代表行程使用或留下的儲能。
quiz.explanationEn: Battery-energy change represents stored energy used or retained by the trip.

steps.title: 把功率曲線換成能量
steps.titleEn: Convert a power profile into energy
steps.objectiveEn: Separate kW and kWh through time integration.
steps.instruction: 使用虛構輪端需求：10kW維持6分鐘、20kW維持3分鐘。各自換算小時後求能量，再畫等能量但不同峰值的另一條曲線。
steps.instructionEn: Use fictional wheel demand of 10 kW for 6 minutes and 20 kW for 3 minutes. Convert time to hours, calculate each energy and sketch another profile with equal energy but a different peak.
steps.observation: 兩段各1kWh，總計2kWh；峰值與累積量不同。
steps.observationEn: Each interval is 1 kWh, totaling 2 kWh; peak and accumulation differ.
steps.failure: 把分鐘直接乘上kW卻標成kWh，會產生60倍單位錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying minutes by kW and labeling the result kWh creates a factor-of-60 error.
steps.check: 每段保留時間換算，總面積為2kWh。
steps.checkEn: Retain each time conversion and obtain a total area of 2 kWh.

knowledge.title: 功率積分
knowledge.text: 固定功率下E=Pt，變動功率則累加分段面積。
knowledge.textEn: For constant power E=Pt; varying power requires summing interval areas.

knowledge.title: 峰值需求
knowledge.text: 相同總能量仍可能需要不同的峰值供能能力。
knowledge.textEn: Equal total energy can require different peak power capability.

quiz.question: 20kW維持3分鐘的能量是多少？
quiz.questionEn: How much energy is 20 kW sustained for 3 minutes?

steps.title: 畫出功率分流的两條路徑
steps.objective: 區分機械傳遞與電力轉換路徑。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish mechanical transmission from electrical conversion.
steps.instruction: 參照Toyota公開系統圖，原創重畫引擎到車輪的機械路徑及經發電機、電力系統、馬達的路徑。再畫電池可接入的位置，不把某次分流比例寫成固定常數。
steps.instructionEn: Using Toyota’s public system diagram as a reference, redraw the engine-to-wheel mechanical path and the path through generator, electrical system and motor. Add the battery connection without treating one power split as a fixed ratio.
steps.observation: 車輪可由不同能量路徑共同驅動，路徑需隨情境辨識。
steps.observationEn: Different energy paths can contribute to wheel drive and must be identified by scenario.
steps.failure: 把所有引擎能量都畫成先進電池，混淆功率分流與純串聯系統。
steps.failureEn: Routing all engine energy through the battery confuses power splitting with a purely series system.
steps.check: 兩條路徑都可從引擎追蹤到車輪，電池為儲能分支。
steps.checkEn: Trace both paths from engine to wheels, showing the battery as storage.

knowledge.title: 分流裝置
knowledge.text: 公開THS架構把引擎功率分配到機械與發電路徑。
knowledge.textEn: The public THS architecture distributes engine power between mechanical and generation paths.

knowledge.title: 轉換損失
knowledge.text: 經過不同轉換次數的路徑，損失與限制不一定相同。
knowledge.textEn: Paths with different conversion stages need not have equal losses or limits.

quiz.question: 哪張圖較符合公開THS分流概念？
quiz.questionEn: Which diagram better matches the public THS power-split concept?
options: 引擎同時可連向車輪及發電機
引擎所有能量都必須先存入電池
引擎僅機械驅動車輪，電機僅用於起動
optionsEn: The engine can connect toward both wheels and generator
All engine energy must first be stored in the battery
The engine only drives mechanically and the electrical machine only starts it
quiz.explanation: 功率分流包含機械路徑，不是所有能量都必經電池。
quiz.explanationEn: Power splitting includes a mechanical path; not all energy must pass through the battery.

steps.title: 閱讀行星齒輪的速度約束
steps.objective: 理解三個轉速並非可任意獨立選擇。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand that three rotational speeds are not independent.
steps.instruction: 用理想教學齒輪關係(Ns+Nr)ωc=Nsωs+Nrωr，假設Ns=1、Nr=2，令ωs=0、ωr=3，求ωc。圖上只標太陽輪、環齒輪及行星架，不聲稱這是任一Prius的齒數。
steps.instructionEn: Use the ideal teaching relation (Ns+Nr)ωc=Nsωs+Nrωr with Ns=1, Nr=2, ωs=0 and ωr=3. Solve for ωc. Label sun, ring and carrier without claiming these are Prius tooth counts.
steps.observation: 三項轉速受同一幾何關係約束，結果ωc=2。
steps.observationEn: The three speeds share one kinematic constraint, giving ωc=2.
steps.failure: 把三個轉速各自任意設置，通常無法同時符合齒輪嚙合關係。
steps.failureEn: Arbitrarily choosing all three speeds generally violates the gear constraint.
steps.check: 將結果代回等式，左右兩側皆為6。
steps.checkEn: Substitute the result and obtain 6 on both sides.

knowledge.title: 運動約束
knowledge.text: 齒輪嚙合限制相對運動，不等於固定所有軸的轉速比例。
knowledge.textEn: Gear engagement constrains relative motion without fixing every shaft-speed ratio.

knowledge.title: 模型層級
knowledge.text: 理想速度方程未包含損失、控制器或實際零件限制。
knowledge.textEn: An ideal speed equation excludes losses, controllers and actual component limits.

quiz.question: 此例的行星架轉速ωc為多少？
quiz.questionEn: What is the carrier speed ωc in this example?

steps.titleEn: Compare operating efficiency with trip fuel use
